correction_reason: Sequence 2 updated three test files but missed a fourth: project/tests/test_gateway_ui_release_contract.py::test_gateway_and_health_have_one_hf_backend_route_without_azure_fallback still asserted that gateway.js contains 'parsed.hostname.endsWith(".hf.space")'. After the gateway.js fix (sequence 2 source commit) this assertion fails because the HF Space validation was intentionally removed. The test is updated to assert the opposite: the HF Space check is absent and CANONICAL_RENDER_BACKEND_ORIGIN is present. No source change needed — only the test contract.
rationale: The release contract test for the gateway was not in the plan's scope and was not caught by the node suite (it is a Python test). CI caught it. The fix is test-only: update the assertion to match the corrected gateway.js contract (Render-only, no HF Space).
